verdict.rationale: Preparing hiring paperwork is a fair question for a full-service law firm, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no employment practice that drafts offer letters, employment agreements, or invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements. The only touchpoints are adjacent: employee share schemes, management packages and IP/trade-secret work, which mention 'employment expertise' only within share-plan design.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm prepares hiring paperwork — offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements — as part of a documented employment practice
